description: Ambient reactions to player silliness. Runtime polarity is determined only by hearts: negative hearts use negative lines; zero or positive hearts use positive lines. Inhibition informs authored voice only, never branch selection.

positive: Ha! All right, that was funny.
negative: Enough. You're making a nuisance of yourself.

positive: Heh. Well, I suppose not everything worth doing needs a practical purpose.
negative: Easy now. Foolishness stops being charming when it starts making work for everybody else.

positive: ...That was really stupid. I liked it.
negative: I know how to be ridiculous too. I just don't want to be ridiculous with you.

positive: HA! Now that's how you make an entrance, partner!
negative: If you're gonna make a spectacle of yourself, at least make it a good one.

positive: I shouldn't laugh at that—oh, Breath, I'm laughing at that.

positive: HA! That's the sort of nonsense a good day needs!

positive: Ha! Well, would ya look at you. That got me.
